blocks.text: SYDNEY — When her identical twin girls were born about two and a half months prematurely, almost everything that followed was out of mom Hannah Topp’s control. Because of their vulnerability, Harriet and Matilda had to go straight to the neonatal intensive care unit at Sydney’s Westmead Hospital. Hannah and her husband Luke were barely able to touch them. Then tragedy struck.
